findings.description: Address-keyed throttling via @limiter.limit("5/minute") combined with a per-identity lockout check (seconds_remaining) before authentication; a locked identity receives the same generic 401 as a wrong password, with no 429 or Retry-After that would tell an attacker the threshold had tripped.

MAX_FAILED_LOGINS=5 with a 15-minute LOCKOUT_WINDOW; authenticate_user checks user.locked_until before verifying the password so a blocked attempt neither spends argon2 CPU nor becomes distinguishable by response time, and failed_logins/locked_until are cleared on success.

findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] Both lockout and throttling are present on the credential path. app/apis/auth/services/get_token_service.py:24,43-51 applies @limiter.limit("5/minute") and refuses an identity already locked (seconds_remaining) with exactly the generic 401 a wrong password returns, with no 429 or Retry-After to signal the threshold. app/apis/auth/utils/utils.py:87-110 enforces MAX_FAILED_LOGINS=5 with a 15-minute LOCKOUT_WINDOW, checks locked_until before any argon2 verification so blocked attempts are not distinguishable by timing, and resets the counters on success | verdict=pass confidence=high
